m.aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Hanumān, of auspicious form; you are the infinite god, the most auspicious of the auspicious.
m.aarti.pad1: The thunderbolt and the banner shine in your hand; a sacred thread of muñja grass adorns your shoulder. You are the son of Śiva and the son of Kesarī; your radiance and might are great, and the world bows to you.
m.aarti.pad2: Your loincloth is red and both your eyes are red; like a mountain you tear through armies. In battle your war-cry is death to the foe, death before its time; in boundless anger you lay waste the enemy's land.
m.aarti.pad3: You are Śrī Rāma's messenger, the abode of matchless strength; the son of Añjanī, known by the name Pavanasuta, son of the Wind. You are the great hero, valiant, Bajaraṅgī with limbs hard as the thunderbolt; you drive away evil thoughts and keep company with good ones.
m.aarti.pad4: Maṅgala, son of the Earth, rains down gold, and grants kingdom and throne, city and country. He cuts down the enemies again and again and casts them to the ground, and removes bonds, illness and calamity.
m.aarti.pad5: You alone can hold your own might; the three worlds tremble at your roar. All who come to your refuge find every happiness; with you as protector, why fear anyone?
m.aarti.pad6: The whole world worships you; show mercy, and grant your boundless gracious gaze. As Śrī Rāma's rod you punish even Death; when you touch him, he is broken in pieces.
m.aarti.pad7: Son of the Wind and son of the Earth, ascetics free of the world, accomplish the work together. Every creature has come to your refuge and bowed its head at your lotus feet.
m.aarti.pad8: Disease, grief and many calamities have closed in; poverty, sorrow and bonds have arisen. Apart from you there is no one else to remove them; you are both great heroes beyond measure.
m.aarti.pad9: You burn away poverty and the dread of debt; destroy disease, sorrow and bad dreams. Make enemies the servants of your feet; you are the master, and we are your servants.
m.aarti.pad10: O Maṅgala, god who takes away calamity, accept this service. I am a joyful devotee, and this is my plea: give great wealth, lakhs and crores.
m.aarti.pad11: This āratī of Śrī Maṅgala is sung together with Hanumān's. When wishes are fulfilled, at the end one goes to the abode of Viṣṇu.
